findings: Native95BA70 converts each signed integer coordinate to float32, multiplies by0.25, truncates back to signed integer. Float32 rounding precedes scaling.
The output preserves order and multiplicity, including zero-sized and invalid sentinel rectangles. No clipping, union, merging or filtering occurs in this helper.
